commands.name: Memory Preset
commands.effect: Fill index buffer; repeat records redundancy

commands.name: Border Preset
commands.effect: Set outer6px horizontal/12px vertical bands; retain interior

commands.name: Tile Block XOR
commands.effect: XOR chosen4-bit index into existing index, not RGB

commands.name: Scroll Preset
commands.effect: 0 none;1 right6/down12;2 left6/up12; fill newly exposed area

commands.name: Scroll Copy
commands.effect: Coarse movement wraps instead of filling

conflicts.detail: Informal safe-area prose294x204 differs from explicit border coordinates and288x192 implementations. Preserve full300x216; optional288x192 crop is declared policy.
Single-index implementations and current FFmpeg alpha-table interpretation differ. No universal detector or Serato choice established.
CDGFix documents16 channels; examined decoders commonly ignore tile channel bits. All-channel playback baseline proposed, selective channel bit mapping deferred.

independentDecoderProposal.timingBoundary: Process packets0..floor(t*300) inclusive, clamped to last complete packet; packet0 PTS0. Reject nonfinite/negative time.
independentDecoderProposal.clock: Original audio track position from engine, not RAF count or wall time.
independentDecoderProposal.seek: Reset/replay or restore a complete checkpoint then replay; never jump byte offset alone.
independentDecoderProposal.crop: Full300x216 canonical; optional288x192 visible crop includes fine offsets.
independentDecoderProposal.validation: Ignore unsupported/timing packets but retain their clock slots; skip entire invalid tile; diagnose trailing bytes; no implicit resynchronization or parity-correction claim.
independentDecoderProposal.memoryRepeatPolicy: Apply each valid Memory Preset including repeats; this follows command semantics, not an assertion of identical redundant-repeat optimization across players.
independentDecoderProposal.malformedScrollPolicy: Reserved direction3 means no coarse shift; clamp invalid fine offsets to5/11 and report.
independentDecoderProposal.initialPixels: Declared independent opaque black/index0 state; no palette-index transparency unless instruction28 sets it.
independentDecoderProposal.copyPolicy: Original implementation from format facts; no external decoder code or media copied.

implementationModels.karaoke: One immutable paired audio/CDG asset record; one decoder state per deck; graphics follows actual engine.position in original track seconds; worker jobs and commits guarded by deck+asset generation. Parse remains independent from Canvas presentation.
implementationModels.mediaCrate: Separate ordered catalog with enabled/random/cursor; loader chooses explicit associated video first, fallback only when eligible. Keep explicit source provenance. Resolve asynchronous loads with per-deck generation and preserve current valid media until replacement commits.
implementationModels.transitionSelection: Separate enabled/random/selected state from continuous autoCrossfade. One logical external track-load transaction selects once, including when it also selects fallback video. This deduplication is independent policy until reference observed.
implementationModels.fxCoupling: Explicit opt-in semantic bridge from audio FX state (effect identity, enabled, assignments, amount, beat timing, lifecycle) to dedicated visual processors. Spectral reactive effects remain distinct. First supported links Echo/Distortion only, with original mappings and clear unsupported state for others.
implementationModels.unsupportedReference: No end-of-clip autoplay or global unverified59-effect mapping fabricated; choose and label independent policies when implementation scope requires them.

acceptance.name: Packet timing
acceptance.criterion: Synthetic command at packet300 changes pixels at1.000s, not just before; non-CDG/timing packets still occupy slots; record chosen inclusive packet0 boundary.

acceptance.name: CLUT repaint
acceptance.criterion: Load both palette halves, draw indices, then recolor without redrawing tiles; existing pixels change; black0 and white4095 render correct8-bit endpoints.

acceptance.name: Tile geometry
acceptance.criterion: Asymmetric6x12 pattern at first/last valid cells verifies bit5-left orientation, row/column masks and exact edge pixels.

acceptance.name: XOR identity
acceptance.criterion: Two equal XOR tiles restore original indices even when two palette entries share the same RGB.

acceptance.name: Presets
acceptance.criterion: Memory fills whole300x216; border changes exactly6/12 edge bands; interior sentinel unchanged; repeats follow declared policy.

acceptance.name: Scroll matrix
acceptance.criterion: All four coarse directions, preset fill vs copy wrap, combined H/V, fine offsets0/5/11, offset-only updates and crop sampling verify actual pixels.

acceptance.name: Transparency
acceptance.criterion: Index profile key0 and key15 become alpha0; other colors remain opaque; changing key updates prior pixels. Optional alpha-table profile tested independently and explicitly labeled.

acceptance.name: Clock and seeks
acceptance.criterion: Audio marker+graphics marker at normal/.5x/2x/pause/forwardseek/backseek/reverse/loop; fresh decode at each target equals stateful output; no RAF-count drift.

acceptance.name: Malformed stream
acceptance.criterion: Empty/23byte/trailing1..23bytes, unknown commands, high P/Q bits, row18/31 and col50/63, reserved scroll, nonfinite time; no out-of-bounds writes, hang or stale prior-track frame.

acceptance.name: Ownership/recovery
acceptance.criterion: Slow pairA then fast pairB; lateA cannot commit; cancel/eject clears pixels and callbacks; invalid pair leaves an explicit diagnostic and audio authority; disposal rejects reuse.

acceptance.name: Paired import
acceptance.criterion: Both local files required; mismatches/duplicates use explicit chooser; ZIP instructions are honest; reload requires reimport; original generated bytes/audio only.

acceptance.name: Real pipeline
acceptance.criterion: Actual Canvas RGBA through channelFX/overlays/transition/masterFX and browser capture; pixel alpha/color samples and audible/visual synchronization, not an imported-file label alone.

acceptance.name: Eligibility
acceptance.criterion: Enabled fallback applies to audio-only external loads, associated video wins, disabled mode does not replace; exact committed source provenance visible.

acceptance.name: Selection controls
acceptance.criterion: Sequential Next and injected deterministic Random choose actual distinct marker clips; one-item/empty crates and repeated random outcomes follow declared policy.

acceptance.name: Transport
acceptance.criterion: Selected fallback actually plays while its audio plays; pause/resume and link/unlink behavior declared; source video audio never duplicates master.

acceptance.name: End policy
acceptance.criterion: Short video + longer audio observes declared loop/hold/advance behavior. No claim that proposed behavior is vendor end-of-clip autoplay.

acceptance.name: Race/failure
acceptance.criterion: LoadA slow/loadB fast; pending fallback after explicit video/cancel cannot commit; corrupt candidate reports and recovers; URL resources released after replacement.

acceptance.name: Transition interaction
acceptance.criterion: Automatic transition selected once per external load transaction; explicit Next works; Random affects selection only; fader motion remains separate.

acceptance.name: Actual semantic trigger
acceptance.criterion: Static source, flat/silent spectrum: enabling assigned audio Echo changes target video. Inject bass-only audio with FX disabled proves spectral-reactive and semantic links are distinct.

acceptance.name: Assignment and params
acceptance.criterion: Left/right/master isolation; amount/beat length controls actual visual state; unsupported audio effects show unavailable rather than silently substituting.

acceptance.name: Lifecycle
acceptance.criterion: FX disable/switch/reassign/load/pause/seek/stop/silence/reverse and repeated frame handling obey declared history/tail reset policy; late loads cannot resurrect links.

acceptance.name: Noninterference
acceptance.criterion: Link off restores independently configured video slots, audio waveform output unchanged by bridge, preset storage contains opt-in metadata only.

acceptance.name: Reduced Motion
acceptance.criterion: Flash/zoom/trails suppressed under reduced motion; semantic event state remains observable without movement; no arbitrary audio-to-visual mapping inferred.
